commonProcedure.cast: Action; V,S,F; base26RP; exact Cleric/Wizard rank9 at class17+ with actual known/prepared acquisition. All five use Divination. Cosmic Revelation range100ft; others120ft. Hidden protection/unknown content resolves after commitment without a diagnostic. Pay strain-adjusted RP, update actual class Dissonance/Refrain, then permit actual source-qualified Counterspell reactions last-in first-out. A paid failed/countered cast refunds nothing. No general Overcast or free acquired spell.
commonProcedure.resources: Limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,castMod)); read pre-cast D. At L/L+3/L+6 add1/2/3RP; at L+6 ordinary ranked casting blocked. BaseD2 for rank9; Refrain increases0/1/2/3 for successive same-family casts, capped3; idle turns do not reset Refrain. A different named spell breaks Refrain. Wizard Spell Efficiency discounts the next same prepared matrix within its real next-turn deadline by1RP (minimum1); acquired Arcane Feedback restores1RP only after a successful actual Counterspell. Knowledge Shield adds2 to the next qualifying ally save within its original deadline. Wizard first prepared family baseD0 only; no Refrain exemption. Cleric ordinary spell generates normal strain; no Conviction vent without actual qualifying Rite/Invocation expenditure. Optional class features are not automatically spent.
commonProcedure.truth: Keep authoritative fact versions, their actual sources, private memory/belief versions, institutional records, divine-channel answers and conditional forecasts in different records. A software log is evidence, not a character sense or omniscient validation channel. Actual Director-established facts can be inputs without a database, but no invented source, lore, faction roster or missing formula is a positive witness. Nonexistent established facts differ from unprovided facts.
commonProcedure.audience: Director audit stores full evidence privately. Recipient data contains only legitimately disclosed payloads, their observation time and permitted provenance. No total queried event count, hidden IDs, gaps, negative roster certification or reasons for unavailable results. Independent readable records can give historical reports about a protected subject; never validate those through the protected current subject. No new spell grants sight, LoE, proficiency, faction membership, standing or command.
commonProcedure.defenses: Protection from Scrying is new-information protection about its actual subject, not blanket immunity to every Divination consequence. Seal Vision blocks actual Divination components at its exact operator/recipient/observation loci. Abjuration Mind Blank blocks fresh bearer information and actual mind-affecting spell components; do not import its unacquired Enchantment/Universal modes. Antimagic uses current149 input/output and clocks. Condition-only immunity blocks only its condition. Source-specific immunity cannot be replaced with a generic rank9 bypass. No pending MD196/AG190/TF192/CC194 proposal supplies a defense or permission.
commonProcedure.clocks: The cases use the accepted equal-cost orthogonal/diagonal grid metric in three axes and actual occupied-body intersection; the recorded casting anchor fixes the center. No new off-grid geometry system is approved. All regular starts/ends remain actor-specific6second schedules. Record action/bonus/reaction refresh and spending, recharge and Ready expiry at each actual start. Extra Actions, source pulses and copied effects are not regular turns. Absolute deadlines and original regular markers persist through absence, modes, initiative reorder and suppression. Death/lifecycle rules and source dependencies apply separately. No die result or action is generated merely to fill a clock.
commonProcedure.knowledgeAftermath: Once legitimately acquired, knowledge is ordinary timestamped memory, not an ongoing Divination feed. Later dispel/Null/Seal does not erase the historical learning. Current accepted Mind Wipe may hide its captured accessible memories; preserve full original versions and later new experiences. Removal reveals only that seal's still-valid captured versions, never a global reset. Held Mind Collapse/Unravel Identity supply no joint restoration rule.
commonProcedure.research: Payload comprehension is explicit. Generic revelation grants no skill, Advanced mark, library receipt, missing Equation text or automatic Hunt. Equivalent genuinely functional dangerous knowledge, if source-authorized, invokes the actual separate KT/PT and warning/commitment/Hunt interfaces. No positive functional Equation payload is fabricated here; that content branch remains held. Q6 ceiling, unresolved identities, current owner corrections and staged revelation remain controlling.
commonProcedure.persistence: Persist casts, commitments, source IDs/ranks/schools, clocks, query slot states, protection inputs, subject/object custody, complete fact and memory versions and public/private output separately. procedureContent.payload: NEW CR198-TRUTH: convey a meaningful finite set of established truths about reality, with provenance and comprehension, to every eligible unblocked mind. This review selects a fixed bounded core: ordinary political peace is not the ontological loss of meaningful difference; mortal theological labels alone do not establish objective divine identities; Calan'thir and Asmodeus genuinely established the public Crucible layer. Current source/owner qualifications remain part of each truth. This is a private spell-local experiential clarification of these existing propositions, not new cosmology, a deity biography, Heartcell authorship, Equation text or blanket public-book disclosure. More specific campaign revelation requires its actual established content and earned ladder/gate; do not invent or silently bypass that gate. Missing dependent content holds that branch.
procedureContent.stun: NEW CR198-DURATION: after delivery, each recipient capable of actually comprehending at least one substantive truth makes the printed WIS save using the actual casting class DC. On failure apply full native Stunned for one round: ends at its first future regular END, excluding the end of a target turn already underway. Outside initiative use6elapsedseconds, preserving that deadline on mode change. No repeat save, concentration, damage-break or extra save is added. Full Stunned means Incapacitated/noAction/BA/Reaction, no movement, automaticSTR/DEXfailure, attacks against have advantage and faltering speech; newly effective incapacitation ends actual concentration immediately.
procedureContent.components: NEW causal selection: the stun requires actual received comprehensible revelation. A save success still learns. Stunned immunity or an already-used source→target hard-denial allowance prevents only stun; truth remains. No reaction-loss fallback. A newly blocked mental payload produces no new stun. Protection from Scrying alone does not block receiving unrelated truths because this spell obtains no bearer facts. Seal Vision and Abjuration Mind Blank prevent the actual affected Divination/mind-affecting components. This card has NO native regardless-of-resistances clause; the request's misplaced phrase is resolved against the exact card, not imported from Divine Truth.
procedureContent.lifecycle: The information transfer is instantaneous; NEW its finite Stunned child is an ongoing rank9 Divination condition with its source and original endpoint. Suppression temporarily disables that child while its clock continues; lawful return before expiry resumes it without rerolling or refunding guard. Actual eligible dispel ends the child only. Caster death does not end a nonconcentration child, recipient death ends current expression. Neither immunity nor expiry restores ended concentration or erases learned truth. Repeat casts obey one shared source-character hard guard while independently delivering permitted new knowledge.
